newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian railways to invest up to 220 mln marks.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian railways to invest up to 220 mln marks.

text.p: Slovenian state-owned railway Slovenske Zeleznice (SZ) said on Thursday it planned to buy 33 new trains, which were expected to cost the company up to 220 million German marks.

"The first buying contracts are expected to be signed this year. If all goes well it could even happen in the next two to three months," Vojko Krasevec, consultant to the general manager of SZ, told Reuters.
"We are still in the process of chosing the most appropriate offer. The exact amount of money to be spent is not yet known, but it is expected to be between 180 and 220 million marks," Krasevec said.
SZ will chose among offers from Adtranz, Moravskoslezka Vagonka, Siemens, Fiat, Breda, GEC Alsthom and DWA.
